sourcesContent: export const ABOUT_ME_TEXT = 'This website started out as a portfolio for my coding projects and experiences, but the more I worked on it, the more I realized that I wanted to showcase another aspect of myself. I thought about how there is more to me than just the "tech" side of things. There is more to me than what my coding experiences have been like. Art has been an important part of my life since I was young, but it has been something that has come and gone. But recently, in my journey of self discovery, I decided to dive into art more and make it a constant part of my life. Even with this change in my focus to art, I am not separating from computer science since it is still an important part of my life. With this website, I hope to not only showcase my skills in both fields, but also who I am.'
